_readme: Field-level overrides PATCHED into the LIVE server config files (we never store the whole vanilla/mod file - a game/mod update rewrites the baseline and these re-apply on top BY NAME, so updates are inherited, not fought). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Each patch is a target-file -> {selector -> value} map. XML selectors are XPath: an attribute node (//var[@name='X']/@value) or an element's text (//type[@name='AKM']/nominal). JSON selectors are a dotted key path (chanceToSpawn, or a.b.c). files.<relpath> targets one file under the server dir. mpmissions.common is applied to EVERY mission's files first; mpmissions.<mission> is applied AFTER common and WINS on conflict; its file keys are relative to that mission dir (e.g. db/globals.xml). Applied by Apply-ConfigOverrides.ps1 during a deploy: report-only by default, patches under -Fix. Each patch is independent and FAIL-SOFT - a missing file or unmatched selector is logged as a WARN and skipped, never aborting the rest. NOT managed here (FULL-FILE OWNED, authored wholesale in deploy/): profiles/AI_Bandits/DynamicAIB.json and StaticAIB.json - see deploy/profiles/AI_Bandits/README.md.

NewsFeedTexts.m_Text: Play nice, hold your fire, and have fun

profiles/ExpansionMod/AIPatrols.control.._readme: ExpansionAI map-point spawn control, read by Build-AIPatrols.ps1 - the Expansion twin of DynamicAIB.common flags.useSpawnLocations. INDEPENDENT of BanditAI: this switch only governs Expansion patrols composed from map points; it never touches AIB. enabled=1 composes every 'expansion'-toggled map point into AIPatrolSettings.json as a ROAMING patrol (base + ours). enabled=0 emits the frozen base ONLY (no map-point patrols) - reversible, authored/base patrols untouched. categoryLoadouts maps a point's category token to an Expansion loadout file (filename stem under profiles/ExpansionMod/Loadouts/); unmapped categories use defaultLoadout. A point may override per-point via its own faction/loadout/count fields. Editable in the Server Files UI as 'ExpansionAI-patrols'.

dayzOffline.sakhal._readme: Fresh-spawn loadout (Expansion SpawnSettings.json). PATCH only these fields so the rest of the file (SpawnLocations, cooldowns, clothing pools) stays whatever the box + map/inventory sync manages, and an Expansion update that rewrites the baseline is inherited. UpperGear = knife + heatpack only (no rags/apple); Backpacks emptied so fresh spawns carry no bag. Re-applied by prestart every start. Sakhal-scoped (only live map; heatpack is for its cold) - promote the knife/backpack bits to mpmissions.common if more maps go live. Spawn stats are PINNED here (health 100 = full; energy/water 2500 each) because an Expansion baseline reset (m_Version bump) reverted SpawnEnergyValue/SpawnWaterValue to a low 500 default, making fresh spawns immediately hungry AND thirsty - pinning them means a future reset can't reintroduce that. 2500 buffers Sakhal's cold drain; lower toward ~1100/900 for a harder start.
